title: Gaming gets hit by memory shortage: A look at Sandisk's $3K PlayStation 5 SSD

summary: The memory shortage is hitting the gaming sphere, with Sandisk's (SNDK) PlayStation 5 storage SSD costing nearly $3,000. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley breaks down the details.
summary_zh: 内存短缺正在影响游戏领域，Sandisk (SNDK) 的 PlayStation 5 存储 SSD 价格接近 3,000 美元。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 详细介绍了这一点。

title: Nasdaq, US stocks slide as Fed forecasts possible rate hike
title_zh: 美联储预测可能加息，纳斯达克、美国股市下滑
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) ended Wednesday's session in negative territory after Federal Reserve officials unanimously voted to hold interest rates at their June FOMC meeting today, while also forecasting at least one possible rate hike ahead.
summary_zh: 美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）周三收盘下跌，此前美联储官员今天在 6 月 FOMC 会议上一致投票决定维持利率不变，同时还预测未来至少有一次可能加息。
